//: Voice-as-character-design example. The `assets` stage writes voice.profile (and project.narrator.profile) as part of the character design; a human or the agent then picks a provider voiceId that fits each brief. Stage options remain as per-run overrides.

characterExcerpt.name: 林默
characterExcerpt.appearance: male, mid-20s, lean build, tired eyes, dark windbreaker
characterExcerpt.personality: 警觉、寡言，被逼到墙角才爆发

voice.profile: 二十多岁男声，偏沙哑，语速快，紧绷警觉

narrator.profile: 中年男声，低沉平稳，纪录片质感，语速慢——与所有角色音明显区分

dubStageConfig.//: No voices/narratorVoice needed when characters and narrator are already cast in the project. Options below OVERRIDE the designed casting for one run (e.g. switching speech providers) without editing any character.

agentUsage.//: The agent can cast a voice that fits the brief without touching config files.

args.name: 王队长
args.voiceProfile: 四十岁男声，沉稳有威，语速中等
